data.name: Ninella
data.gender_notes: Ninella is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Italian name Nina, meaning 'little girl'. The suffix -ella adds a sense of grace and gentleness. The name Ninella carries the meaning “Graceful little girl” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ninella usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful little girl and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name imbued with the grace of God.
data.etymology: Ninella belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful little girl.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ninella total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
